entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 5620098679741674496: position at J2016.0. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, X Pup: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 2533.8 +/- 104.8 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 2533.8 +/- 104.8 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.3763 +/- 0.0201 mas (same row, RUWE 1.04), 18.7 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -1.236, 1.786 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 107.7 +/- 4.8 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, X Pup: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 107.7 +/- 4.8 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5125 +/- 301 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 270, Name='X Pup', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5125 +/- 301 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic).

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,125 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.402 +/- 0.009 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffe8d4. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,125 K and log g 0.58 (u1 0.596, u2 0.147): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Published: log g 0.58 from 2024A&A...690A.246T, the median of its 2 spectra; the 8 published values span log g 0.28 to 1.77, across which the limb law changes by at most 1.7% of the centre brightness.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 5620098679741674496: 5 G-band harmonics of a 25.97135479006247 d period, peak-to-peak 2.485 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.02 of a cycle there.
